books.title: New Grub Street
books.author: George Gissing
books.summary: A group of writers try to hold on to artistic merit in the face of abject poverty in the quickly changing literary and social landscape of Victorian London.

books.title: Waverley
books.author: Walter Scott
books.summary: A young English officer becomes involved in the Jacobite rebellion.

books.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
books.author: Benjamin Franklin
books.summary: Benjamin Franklin writes about his youth, adventures, and achievements.

books.title: Queen Victoria

books.summary: A sardonic and generally unflattering biography of Victoria Alexandrina, Queen of England.

books.title: Indian Fairy Tales
books.author: Joseph Jacobs
books.summary: A collection of fairy tales that exhibits India’s rich folk tale tradition.

books.title: The Birds
books.author: Aristophanes
books.summary: Two Athenians persuade the birds to build them a new city in the sky.

books.title: Pygmalion
books.author: George Bernard Shaw

books.title: Figures of Earth

books.summary: A young swineherd rises to the rank of Count by following his own thinking and desires.

books.title: His Family

books.summary: A man sees his life differently through the eyes of his daughters in turn-of-the-century New York City.

books.title: The Dark Other

books.summary: A young woman seeks the reason behind her lover’s outbursts of cruelty.

books.title: Now It Can Be Told
books.author: Philip Gibbs
books.summary: A British war correspondent recalls his experiences during the Great War.

books.title: The Powerhouse
books.author: John Buchan
books.summary: A secret criminal organization is uncovered after an M.P.’s friend goes missing.

books.title: A Treatise of Human Nature
books.author: David Hume

books.title: Women and Economics

books.summary: Gilman explores the transformation of the role of women in society and the necessity for women to achieve economic independence.

books.title: Lyrical Ballads

books.summary: A collection of pastoral poems that is considered the defining text for the beginning of Romantic-era literature.

books.title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
books.author: E. M. Forster
books.summary: After an English widow on holiday impetuously falls in love with a handsome young Tuscan, her panicked in-laws send a rescue party.

books.title: Gladiator
books.author: Philip Wylie
books.summary: A young man, given superhuman abilities by his scientist father, tries to find purpose and use for his powers.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: H. Beam Piper
books.summary: A collection of science fiction stories by H. Beam Piper ordered by date of publication.

books.title: The Kingdom of God Is Within You
books.author: Leo Tolstoy

books.title: Journals
books.author: Alexander Mackenzie
books.summary: Explorer Alexander Mackenzie details his journeys to both the Arctic and Pacific Oceans in his personal journals.
